description: This file implements a WebSocket-based real-time voice provider bridge for OpenAI, including configuration normalization, connection management, event handling, and integration with the openclaw plugin SDK.

classes.name: OpenAIRealtimeVoiceBridge
classes.description: A WebSocket client managing real-time voice communication with OpenAI, handling connection, reconnection, event processing, and session management.

methods.name: normalizeProviderConfig
methods.description: Normalizes provider configuration, extracting relevant parameters and secrets.

methods.name: readProviderConfig
methods.description: Reads and normalizes the provider configuration.

methods.name: base64ToBuffer
methods.description: Converts a base64 string to a Buffer.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes the WebSocket connection to the OpenAI realtime service.

methods.name: sendAudio
methods.description: Sends audio data as base64-encoded buffer over WebSocket.

methods.name: setMediaTimestamp
methods.description: Updates the latest media timestamp.

methods.name: sendUserMessage
methods.description: Sends a user message event.

methods.name: triggerGreeting
methods.description: Triggers a greeting response with optional instructions.

methods.name: submitToolResult
methods.description: Submits the result of a tool call.

methods.name: acknowledgeMark
methods.description: Acknowledges and removes the earliest mark in the queue.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket connection and marks the bridge as intentionally closed.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns whether the WebSocket is currently connected.

methods.name: doConnect
methods.description: Handles the WebSocket connection establishment, including reconnection logic.

methods.name: resolveConnectionParams
methods.description: Resolves WebSocket URL and headers based on configuration, supporting Azure and OpenAI endpoints.

methods.name: attemptReconnect
methods.description: Retries WebSocket connection with exponential backoff up to a maximum number of attempts.

methods.name: sendSessionUpdate
methods.description: Sends a session update event to initialize or refresh the session.

methods.name: handleEvent
methods.description: Processes incoming WebSocket events, including audio, transcript, function calls, and errors.

methods.name: handleBargeIn
methods.description: Handles user barge-in by truncating ongoing responses.

methods.name: sendMark
methods.description: Creates and queues a mark for synchronization.

methods.name: sendEvent
methods.description: Sends an event object over WebSocket.
